jobs.prompt: The option-answer change for T-0114 is integrated on this branch (decisions answered by exact option via { choice } on prepare and decision; Approve/Deny only for yes/no decisions; answers applied through CLI code paths before auditing), but four end-to-end tests in tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs now fail with 422 instead of 200 (evidence block). Find the cause and fix it correctly: if the tests prepare a decision without a choice, update them to send the exact option the test intends (for yes/no decisions such as hand-build requests, approve/deny remain accepted as an alias for the exact yes/no option, so check that alias works through prepare as well as decision); if production rejects a valid choice (for example option labels built differently from the journal options, the default not included, or the alias not applied in prepare), fix production. The required behaviors stay: a 3-option decision answers exactly the clicked option (journal read back shows that option, not the default); unknown choice 422; bound-choice mismatch 409; audit only after apply; hand-build approve changes the hand-build store; proposed ticket approve/deny; scope apply-failed. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs tests/board-owner-actions-handlers.test.mjs tests/board-owner-actions-ui.test.mjs tests/board-inbox.test.mjs tests/decision-board-safe.test.mjs tests/watch-s4-contract.test.mjs` and report pass counts (must be 0 failures).
